          "TYPES: BEGIN OF tps_mseg,",
          "        mblnr TYPE mseg-mblnr,",
          "        mjahr TYPE mseg-mjahr,",
          "        zeile TYPE mseg-zeile,",
          "        grund TYPE mseg-grund,",
          "       END OF tps_mseg.",
          "",
          "DATA: l_t_mseg_ls TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF mseg,",
          "      l_s_mseg_ls TYPE mseg,",
          "      l_t_mseg    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tps_mseg,",
          "      l_s_mseg    TYPE tps_mseg.",
          "",
          "FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_mseg> TYPE mseg.",
          "",
          "FREE: l_t_mseg_ls,",
          "      l_t_mseg.",
          "\"冲销物料凭证",
          "LOOP AT xmseg INTO l_s_mseg_ls WHERE smbln IS NOT INITIAL AND smblp IS NOT INITIAL .",
          "  APPEND l_s_mseg_ls TO l_t_mseg_ls.",
          "ENDLOOP.",
          "*BREAK-POINT.",
          "IF l_t_mseg_ls IS NOT INITIAL.",
          "",
          "  \"被冲销物料凭证的移动原因",
          "  SELECT mblnr",
          "         mjahr",
          "         zeile",
          "         grund\"移动原因",
          "    INTO TABLE l_t_mseg",
          "    FROM mseg",
          "     FOR ALL ENTRIES IN l_t_mseg_ls",
          "   WHERE mblnr EQ l_t_mseg_ls-smbln",
          "     AND mjahr EQ l_t_mseg_ls-sjahr",
          "     AND zeile EQ l_t_mseg_ls-smblp.",
          "",
          "  SORT l_t_mseg BY mblnr mjahr zeile.",
          "",
          "  LOOP AT xmseg ASSIGNING <fs_mseg> WHERE smbln IS NOT INITIAL AND smblp IS NOT INITIAL.",
          "    READ TABLE l_t_mseg INTO l_s_mseg WITH KEY mblnr = <fs_mseg>-smbln",
          "                                               mjahr = <fs_mseg>-sjahr",
          "                                               zeile = <fs_mseg>-smblp BINARY SEARCH.",
          "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
          "      <fs_mseg>-grund = l_s_mseg-grund.",
          "    ENDIF.",
          "  ENDLOOP.",
          "",
          "ENDIF."
        ]
      }
